limitations: Test groups overlap; their counts are not a unique-test sum.
Healthy ea843 output/guard/TLS runs are inherited only for the unchanged implementation, with all six subsequent changed paths disclosed.
No new M7 or other real-data evaluation was performed; hashes are bindings, never a substitute for execution.
Old 8a54 and b605 source/test evidence and v3 document drafts remain immutable.
Original initial-combination and both eight-failure PostgreSQL runs remain failures at their own identities.
The corrected-combination index.lock startup failure occurred before pytest and is retained separately.
Frozen v4 was never executed; v5 added an actual no-loss reverse-migration assertion before the final commands.
Only ClinicalExtraction.extractor_version was widened; FactExtraction's distinct field was not changed.
Reverse migration succeeds for old short identities; PostgreSQL must reject narrowing when long identities exist, preserving values and applied state.
